page.headline: Be Part of Something Meaningful
page.tagline: Choose how you’d like to join — as a general member or on the team.

generalMember.title: General member
generalMember.description: Open to everyone. Join our community and take part in events, workshops, and activities whenever you like. No commitment required—just show up when you can.

execMember.description: Help run the club—events, outreach, marketing, and more.
